name: Affinity
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
long_description:
Affinity is the AI-powered internal compliance platform for fintechs, banks, and other regulated companies. Teams use Affinity to manage policies and procedures, train employees, and stay audit-ready for bank partners, auditors, and regulators - all in one place.

Compliance teams centralize policies with version control, owners, review cycles, and approvals. Our AI tools turn internal documentation into on-demand guidance for every employee (Cora) and generate custom training in minutes (Imagine). Off-the-shelf courses cover financial services regulation, information security, and HR, and one-click reporting gives partners and examiners the records they ask for. Affinity is SOC 2 Type 2 compliant and integrates with Slack, Okta, Rippling, Google Workspace, and more.

Compliance teams at leading fintechs rely on Affinity, with more than 150,000 training modules completed. We were early team members at Bread, a pay-over-time fintech we helped build from inception through its acquisition, and we built Affinity to be the compliance platform we wished we'd had.
one_liner: The AI-powered internal compliance platform for regulated companies
